title: Microsoft Outlook Troubleshooting Guide
problem: Employee is unable to use Microsoft Outlook normally.

troubleshooting_steps.title: Check Internet Connection
troubleshooting_steps.instruction: Verify that internet or VPN connectivity is available.
troubleshooting_steps.caption: Internet Connection

troubleshooting_steps.title: Restart Outlook
troubleshooting_steps.instruction: Close Outlook completely and reopen it.
troubleshooting_steps.caption: Restart Outlook

troubleshooting_steps.title: Verify Account Status
troubleshooting_steps.instruction: Confirm that the correct Outlook profile is selected and connected.
troubleshooting_steps.caption: Account Settings

troubleshooting_steps.title: Send Test Email
troubleshooting_steps.instruction: Send a test email to yourself and verify delivery.
troubleshooting_steps.caption: Test Email

troubleshooting_steps.title: Restart Computer
troubleshooting_steps.instruction: Restart Windows if Outlook continues to freeze.
troubleshooting_steps.caption: Restart Computer

escalation.condition: Escalate if Outlook still cannot connect after troubleshooting.

faq.question: Can Outlook work without VPN?
faq.answer: Only if the organization allows internet-based Exchange access.

faq.question: Should I recreate my Outlook profile?
faq.answer: Only after guidance from the IT team.
